description: OpenCML Extension for VSCode — GraphIR visualization and Camel debugging
contributes.configuration.title: Camel configuration
contributes.configuration.properties.ope: Path to the Camel executable (e.g. camel or /path/to/camel.exe). Sibling tools (camel-ls, camel-format, camel-db) are auto-detected next to it.
Path to the Camel debugger executable (camel-db). Empty: resolved next to the Camel executable.
TCP port used to talk to the Camel debugger (camel-db serve).
Maximum number of problems produced by the CLI fallback server. Native camel-ls reports all diagnostics.
Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.
Path to camel-ls. Empty: use the tool next to Camel, resolved through camelPath, CAMEL_HOME/bin or PATH. Changes restart the language server.

contributes.debuggers.0.configurationAtt: Absolute path of the CML file to debug.
Port camel-db serves its API on.
Path to camel-db. Default: resolved next to the Camel executable.
Port of a running camel-db instance.
contributes.debuggers.0.configurationSni: Launch camel-db and debug the current CML file.

contributes.semanticTokenModifiers.0.des: A variable or parameter declared with `var`: it can be assigned again, unlike a `let` binding.
contributes.semanticTokenModifiers.1.des: A function declared `sync func`: it has side effects and its calls are kept in order.
configuration.diagnostics.trigger: When to update editor diagnostics. Source synchronization, completion and navigation remain live. Changing this restarts the language server.
configuration.diagnostics.debounceMs: Delay diagnostic requests while typing, in milliseconds. Changing this restarts the language server.
configuration.diagnostics.severityOverri: Override editor diagnostic severity by diagnostic code (case-insensitive). Does not affect compiler exit status.
configuration.gir.followActiveEditor: Follow the active CML source. Toolbar changes are remembered for this workspace.
configuration.gir.refreshOn: Refresh GIR when its source is saved, or only on manual refresh.
configuration.gir.defaultView: Initial GIR browsing mode. Toolbar changes are remembered for this workspace.
configuration.gir.edgeLabels: Show edge indices on hover or focus, always, or never.
configuration.gir.hoverNeighborhood: Highlight upstream, downstream, or both neighboring nodes on hover. Locked exploration remains available when disabled.
configuration.gir.rememberViewport: Restore graph zoom and position when returning to a source or subgraph during this panel session.
configuration.runtime.checkTimeoutMs: Timeout for CLI diagnostics and GIR generation in milliseconds. Does not limit running programs, native LSP analysis, or debugger requests.
configuration.inlayHints.parameterNames: Show parameter names before unambiguous positional arguments.
